news.title: New minor risk - Shareholder dilution
news.body: The company's shareholders have been diluted in the past year. Increase in shares outstanding: 16% This is considered a minor risk. Shareholder dilution occurs when there is an increase in the number of shares on issue that is not proportionally distributed between all shareholders. Often due to the company raising equity capital or some options being converted into stock. All else being equal, if there are more shares outstanding then each existing share will be entitled to a lower proportion of the company's total earnings, thus reducing earnings per share (EPS). news.title: Continental Securities Limited Announces Re-Constitution of Committee, Effective January 12, 2026
news.body: The Board of Directors of Continental Securities Limited at its meeting held on January 12, 2026 have reconstituted the Audit Committee, Nomination and Remuneration Committee, Risk Management Committee & Stakeholder Relationship Committee of the Board with effect from January 12, 2026: The Audit Committee of the Company has been reconstituted and comprises three members. news.title: Chief Financial Officer recently sold ₹1.4m worth of stock
news.body: On the 26th of December, Hemant Gupta sold around 100k shares on-market at roughly ₹14.50 per share. This transaction amounted to 22% of their direct individual holding at the time of the trade. This was the largest sale by an insider in the last 3 months. Hemant has been a net seller over the last 12 months, reducing personal holdings by ₹2.6m.

news.title: Chief Financial Officer recently sold ₹363k worth of stock
news.body: On the 26th of November, Hemant Gupta sold around 25k shares on-market at roughly ₹14.50 per share. This transaction amounted to 5.3% of their direct individual holding at the time of the trade. In the last 3 months, they made an even bigger sale worth ₹830k. Hemant has been a net seller over the last 12 months, reducing personal holdings by ₹1.2m.
